data.name: StorageCorrupt
data.value: Database '{0}' is corrupt. {2} Restore the database from a verified backup.

data.name: StoragePageCorrupt
data.value: Database '{0}' is corrupt on page {1}. {2} Restore the database from a verified backup.

data.name: ObjectOwnedBySchema
data.value: Object '{0}' is owned by schema '{1}' and cannot be changed by {2}. Alter the schema and redeploy it.

data.name: MaintenanceLaneDelayed
data.value: Database '{0}' maintenance worker '{1}' ({2}) is delayed by {3}; the admission cap is 64 and the hard thread ceiling is 128 (running for {4}).

data.name: DatabaseOffline
data.value: Database '{0}' is offline: {1}, so nothing more is written to it. Every operation is refused until the database is reopened (OpenDatabaseAsync); the reopen's recovery reads the journal and decides the outcome of every commit that was not confirmed.

data.name: OperationCommitUnconfirmed
data.value: Database '{0}' went offline while the operation was committing: {1} after the operation's work reached the journal. The operation may or may not have been applied; do not retry it. Reopen the database (OpenDatabaseAsync): its recovery keeps the work if its records reached stable storage and discards it if not, and reading the data back then tells which.

data.name: TransactionCommitUnconfirmed
data.value: Database '{0}' went offline while a transaction was committing: {1} after the transaction's commit record was written. The transaction may or may not have committed; do not retry it. Reopen the database (OpenDatabaseAsync): its recovery keeps the commit if its record reached stable storage and discards it if not, and reading the data back then tells which.
